claims: Built from the Kachujin character supplied in the shared competition assets (assets/mixamo/roster/muse.fbx): same mesh and embedded textures, rescaled to a 1.87 m bind height

All 30 required animation clips are present, taken from the shared Mixamo FBX clips in assets/mixamo with their original names and durations, plus the optional knockdown_front, getup_back and getup_front clips from assets/mixamo/extra
Skeleton uses the standard mixamorig: bone names from the base character (75 bones, including every required bone)
12,609 triangles, 6 embedded textures at up to 2048 px, no external files, GLB 27.2 MB (under the 80 MB limit)

Materials: metallic-roughness factors default (1.0) modulated by a metallic-roughness texture (green = roughness, blue = metalness; skin roughness ~0.60, cloth ~0.85, hair ~0.46; the gold ornaments metallic at roughness 0.34); the painted-eye boxes in that texture are set to roughness 0.07 (measured 0.071 at both eye centres in the exported GLB) so the eyes take a wet specular highlight; the base character's specular texture is unchanged

The normal map is the base character's own, blended with procedural micro-detail masked from the character's diffuse (pore speckle on skin, weave on cloth, strand grooves on hair); v3.8 repaints the painted eyes (sclera, striated iris, limbal ring, pupil, catchlight) at measured eye boxes, adds skin mottling, and densifies the pore speckle; no pore geometry or subsurface scattering is claimed

Skin carries a light clearcoat finish (KHR_materials_clearcoat, roughness 0.35) weighted by a skin mask at 0.28 and zero elsewhere, as a sweat/oil sheen; cloth and hair have no clearcoat. It is a surface finish, not a subsurface-scattering model

Grounding pass on the clips: in every clip except the aerial and floor ones (jump, knocked_out, thrown, knockdown_front, getup_front, getup_back, getting_up), the Hips vertical curve is lowered frame by frame by the measured float of the lowest foot vertex, counting only sustained stance drift (capped at 6 cm); the genuine 22 cm hop inside front_kick is preserved. Verified by sampling skinned vertex heights of the exported GLB in three.js: fighting_idle, walk_forward and block_high now stay within about 1 cm of the floor

brain.js is a pure function that uses only Math (v6, tuned to RULES v3.10 clip-measured reaches): no imports, timers, DOM or network access; it resets its round-time cooldowns when time restarts at a new round (RULES v3.4 round-timer trap); at foe hp <= 30 it hunts the knockdown with the knockdown strikes that still land under RULES v3.10 (hook, roundhouse, spin kick); against a blocking foe it prefers the takedown over the throw; it never throws the five moves RULES v3.10 made unable to land (uppercut, knee, front kick, sweep, combo), and its strike tables are reach-guarded (a move is only thrown when its clip-measured reach + 0.25 m covers the current distance); and it dodges or slips attacks instead of only blocking, because a guard does not stop a grab

source/ in the entry folder holds the exact v3.8 build script (build_fighter.py, including the grounding pass) and texture script (make_detail_maps.py), plus the three.js render page used for renders/
style: Patient counter-striker: long kicks at range, heavy counters in close, takedowns and throws against a guard
